summary: Recover order identity from the per-card slot attribute when Amazon encrypts visible order content, retaining the visible-text fallback.
reason: Amazon can omit order IDs from plaintext while preserving them in the order-card slot. Generic link scraping is unsafe because recommendation session IDs have the same shape as order IDs; unavailable encrypted fields must remain empty.
validated_outcome: A sanitized reconstruction of PR #1116 markup yields three distinct orders instead of zero, preserves exposed date/total/items, and ignores shared session-ID decoys.
